responsibility: Declares the top-level CompileCrate driver for the Rust backend. This small interface represents the crate-wide lowering phase that walks HIR crate items with a compile context, separating overall compilation orchestration from the detailed item, expression, type, and statement compilers.
same_name_distinction: Declares only the top-level CompileCrate driver class for crate-wide lowering orchestration. Unlike rust-compile.cc, it is a narrow interface header and does not define the shared coercion, trait-object, or other backend helper implementations.
